mentions.name: Wave
mentions.description: Open source knowledge base management tool that scales from a single person (consultant/freelancer) to an organization, designed to serve both humans and AI agents, envisioned as an alternative to Confluence.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hi All working on an open source tool to manage knowledge base from one person (consultant/freelancer) to a organization. Built for both humans and Agents.

Currently building for myself and managing my own work with it, would vision something alternative for confluence.
